ritual.mysticalterrain.lirael.day: The dais only answers under the moon
ritual.mysticalterrain.astrael.time: The star core only drinks starlight at midnight
ritual.mysticalterrain.sekhmar.placed: That jar is already in place
ritual.mysticalterrain.hollow_warden.moo: The flame burns, but the Warden only comes under a new moon
ritual.mysticalterrain.pyraxis.hint: Throw a Cinder Heart into the lava by the altar
ritual.mysticalterrain.hrimthane.hint: Ring the four Frost Bells in order, I to IV
ritual.mysticalterrain.lirael.hint: Lay three moonpetals on the dais at night
ritual.mysticalterrain.grothmaw.hint: Set a Primal Egg in the nest and let it hatch
ritual.mysticalterrain.hollow_warden.hin: Light the six Gloom Braziers on a new-moon night
ritual.mysticalterrain.bogrot.hint: Drop a Drowned Idol into the water beside the altar
ritual.mysticalterrain.sekhmar.hint: Place the four canopic jars on the pedestal

ritual.mysticalterrain.archon.hint: Charge the five Rune Pillars with lapis lazuli
ritual.mysticalterrain.astrael.hint: Pour a Starlight Vial on the star core at midnight

ritual.mysticalterrain.archon.begin: The runes align. The Archon assembles.

A vast cleave; a rift tears 10 blocks ahead and erupts.
Three rifts tear open in a fan.
gear.mysticalterrain.voidreaver.alternat: Leap and crash down in a white crater; dive if airborne.
The crater splits into four erupting rifts.
gear.mysticalterrain.voidreaver.charge.d: Hold to lengthen the rift; full charge detonates its end.
Every third hit tears the scars open for 8 magic damage.
gear.mysticalterrain.wyrmspine_glaive.pr: Spin the glaive in a full circle, flinging foes skyward.
A second, wider spin drags them back in.
gear.mysticalterrain.wyrmspine_glaive.al: Dash 10 blocks, raking and launching all in your path.
Your wake erupts in a line of rifts.
gear.mysticalterrain.wyrmspine_glaive.ch: Hold, then hurl a piercing spine; full charge detonates.
The spine flies back to you, striking again.
gear.mysticalterrain.wyrmspine_glaive.pa: Hits launch foes; airborne foes take +6 and are spiked down.
gear.mysticalterrain.endseer_staff.prima: Three homing void orbs, 7 magic damage each.
Five orbs; each impact opens a small singularity.
gear.mysticalterrain.endseer_staff.alter: A gravity well drags foes in for 2.5 s, then collapses.
Wider and longer, with a harder collapse.
gear.mysticalterrain.endseer_staff.charg: Hold to focus; release a lance up to 40 blocks long.
Pierces walls and forks into nearby foes.
gear.mysticalterrain.endseer_staff.passi: Hits mark foes for 8 s; staff abilities deal +30%% to them.
gear.mysticalterrain.emberlord_maul.prim: Smash the ground: detonates Heat and leaves a magma pool.
A ring of hellfire rolls out to 8 blocks: +2 Heat.
gear.mysticalterrain.emberlord_maul.alte: Leap up to 14 blocks and crash down in a magma crater.
gear.mysticalterrain.emberlord_maul.char: Hold to heave: a wider slam; charged, the ground splits.
gear.mysticalterrain.emberlord_maul.pass: +1 Heat per hit; every 3rd hit erupts under the foe.
Dash through foes: +2 Heat each, leaving a trail of fire.
Flash back along the trail and cut them again.
gear.mysticalterrain.cinderfang.alternat: Vault back; your ember effigy explodes. Next hit sears.
The effigy drags foes in first and leaves a magma pool.
gear.mysticalterrain.cinderfang.charge.d: Hold to aim; blink behind a foe and detonate its Heat.
gear.mysticalterrain.cinderfang.charge.e: Chains to two more burning foes.
+1 Heat per hit (+2 on crits); crits speed up Cinder Rush.
gear.mysticalterrain.magmaheart_staff.pr: Lob three globs of slag that burst: +1 Heat, burning ground.
gear.mysticalterrain.magmaheart_staff.al: Erupt all your magma; with none, a vent opens where you aim.
Each eruption hurls two slag globs at nearby foes.
gear.mysticalterrain.magmaheart_staff.ch: Hold to call up to 5 meteors; full charge, a Great Meteor.
Cinder rain keeps falling on foes near the site.
gear.mysticalterrain.magmaheart_staff.pa: +1 Heat per hit; a burst of flame knocks the foe back.
gear.mysticalterrain.rimebreaker_axe.pri: Chop the ground: an icy blast and a ring of spikes. +2 Rime.
A second, wider ring of glacier spikes erupts.
gear.mysticalterrain.rimebreaker_axe.alt: A spinning cleave around you; each foe hit hardens your scales.
Pulls foes in for a second, wider spin.
gear.mysticalterrain.rimebreaker_axe.cha: Hold to raise the axe: a wider crush, +1 Rime per level.
gear.mysticalterrain.rimebreaker_axe.pas: +1 Rime per hit (5 = Frozen Solid); Frozen foes Shatter.
gear.mysticalterrain.glacial_lance.prima: Hurl a piercing lance of ice; fliers are pinned down. +1 Rime.
The lance splits into three at the first foe.
gear.mysticalterrain.glacial_lance.alter: Tunnel forward under the ice, then erupt beneath your foes.
Spikes burst up along the tunnel; a wider eruption.
gear.mysticalterrain.glacial_lance.charg: Hold to aim: a longer, harder lance; full charge raises spikes.
gear.mysticalterrain.glacial_lance.passi: +1 Rime per hit; at 3+ Rime a spike pierces foes behind.
gear.mysticalterrain.icicle_repeater.pri: A three-round burst of icicles. +1 Rime per round.
Five rounds, and the icicles pierce a foe.
gear.mysticalterrain.icicle_repeater.alt: A frost orb: the foe it strikes is Frozen Solid; +3 Rime nearby.
Leaves an ice cage that keeps freezing for 4 s.
gear.mysticalterrain.icicle_repeater.cha: Hold to raise up to 5 ice spears; release to rain them down.
Two more spears; each impact raises an ice spike.
gear.mysticalterrain.icicle_repeater.pas: +1 Rime per hit; each hit cuts Icicle Barrage's cooldown 1 s.
Five seeking moonthorns: +1 Thorn each (2 per foe).
Eight moonthorns in two waves; each pierces a foe.
Briars erupt where you aim: root, +2 Thorns, brambles.
Briars also seize the two nearest foes around it.
Hold: up to 5 moon columns that harvest; full: a Full Moon.
Each column shatters into 3 seeking moon shards.
+1 Thorn per hit; hits on a Blooming foe heal you 2.
gear.mysticalterrain.briar_rapier.primar: Lunge 6 blocks, piercing every foe: +2 Thorns.
The lunge ends in a moonlit crescent cut around you.
gear.mysticalterrain.briar_rapier.altern: Blink behind your target and strike; you are Glamoured.
A petal double stays behind and echoes your hits.
gear.mysticalterrain.briar_rapier.charge: Hold en garde: parry a blow within 1 s to riposte, harvest.
The riposte's crescent cleaves every foe within 5.
gear.mysticalterrain.briar_rapier.passiv: +1 Thorn per hit, +2 on critical hits.
gear.mysticalterrain.petalstorm_fan.prim: A cutting gust: +1 Thorn, knockback; blows away missiles.
Three gusts in a row, the last reaching 12 blocks.
gear.mysticalterrain.petalstorm_fan.alte: Spin-cut around you, then spring up into a glide: +2 Thorns.
You land in a second, wider whirl.
gear.mysticalterrain.petalstorm_fan.char: Hold to gather a petal storm; hurl it to drag, shred, harvest.
Monsters it held are Beguiled and fight each other.
gear.mysticalterrain.petalstorm_fan.pass: +1 Thorn; hitting a Blooming foe cuts 2 more nearby.
gear.mysticalterrain.tyrants_fang.primar: Slam the fang down: bone spikes erupt in a line ahead.
Three lines erupt in a fan, each ending in amber tar.
gear.mysticalterrain.tyrants_fang.altern: Leap and crash down, cracking the ground around you.
A higher leap, a wider crater and a rolling shock ring.
gear.mysticalterrain.tyrants_fang.charge: Hold to gather fury; release to split the earth apart.
gear.mysticalterrain.tyrants_fang.passiv: Knocks foes back; every third hit sets off a tremor.
gear.mysticalterrain.raptor_talons.prima: Leap onto the foe in your sights and rake it.
Chain up to two more pounces onto nearby foes.
gear.mysticalterrain.raptor_talons.alter: Three spectral raptors rush out, raking all they pass.
Five raptors run out and circle back for a second pass.
gear.mysticalterrain.raptor_talons.charg: Hold to coil; a longer pounce that tears the wound open.
gear.mysticalterrain.raptor_talons.passi: Hits stack bleeding; at 5 stacks the wound tears open.
gear.mysticalterrain.fossil_greataxe.pri: Spin like the tyrant's tail, cleaving all around you.
Spin once more and leave a ring of burning amber.
gear.mysticalterrain.fossil_greataxe.alt: Chop a crawling amber fissure that entombs foes it crosses.
Three fissures fan out; shattered tombs burst outward.
gear.mysticalterrain.fossil_greataxe.cha: Hold to wind up; each level adds a spin and more reach.
gear.mysticalterrain.fossil_greataxe.pas: Hits coat foes in sap; at 4 coats they fossilize in amber.
gear.mysticalterrain.soulreaper_scythe.p: A vast soul-drinking sweep that hooks foes in.
A return cut follows, reaping Condemned foes.
gear.mysticalterrain.soulreaper_scythe.a: Chain a foe, drag it to you and slam it down.
The chain forks to 3 foes; the slam shakes the ground.
gear.mysticalterrain.soulreaper_scythe.c: Hold, then drop a spectral blade; executes Condemned.
Two more blades fall at your flanks.
gear.mysticalterrain.soulreaper_scythe.p: Heals you; every 2nd hit adds a Sentence.
gear.mysticalterrain.shadowstep_dagger.p: Blink behind your target and cut; vanish briefly.
Step through up to two more nearby foes.
gear.mysticalterrain.shadowstep_dagger.a: Lunge, stab and turn: Sentences burst; 3+ resets Shadowstep.
The lock springs, bursting on nearby foes too.
gear.mysticalterrain.shadowstep_dagger.c: Hold, then dash through foes; your trail detonates.
The trail burns as soul chains for 3 seconds.
gear.mysticalterrain.shadowstep_dagger.p: Hits from behind burst for magic and add a Sentence.
gear.mysticalterrain.lantern_of_souls.pr: Loose three homing souls, each adding a Sentence.
Five souls that pierce through a foe.
gear.mysticalterrain.lantern_of_souls.al: Drop a spectral cell that imprisons foes inside.
A wider cell that drains its prisoners to heal you.
gear.mysticalterrain.lantern_of_souls.ch: Hold to gather souls; release to raise soul pyres.
Two more pyres, and their fires burn longer.
gear.mysticalterrain.lantern_of_souls.pa: Adds a Sentence and burns; 5 Sentences Condemn a foe.
Loose 3 homing marsh-fire wisps; they drag fliers down.
Five wisps that fork into sparks on impact.
gear.mysticalterrain.hags_crook.alternat: Drowned hands seize foes where you aim, then drag them under.
A wider grasp that leaves a pool of black water.
gear.mysticalterrain.hags_crook.charge.d: Hold to weave a hex circle; foes inside are cursed.
gear.mysticalterrain.hags_crook.charge.e: The hex leaps to a new foe when its victim dies.
Adds Rot and hooks foes in; hexed foes call a wisp.
A wide serrated cleave that bleeds foes and heals you.
A second backhand cleave; healing is doubled.
gear.mysticalterrain.leechblade.alternat: Tether nearby foes, then drink their blood and all their Rot.
The tethers drag foes to you and drink faster.
gear.mysticalterrain.leechblade.charge.d: Hold to coil; lunge through foes and latch a leech on.
Heals on hit, more from Rotting foes; every 3rd hit bleeds.
Lob 3 bile globs that burst and leave poison pools.
Five globs; wider pools that last longer.
gear.mysticalterrain.bogspitter.alternat: Belch swamp gas, then ignite it; your bile pools explode.
A wider, longer cone that keeps burning for 3 s.
gear.mysticalterrain.bogspitter.charge.d: Hold to swell the gourd; rings of bile erupt where you aim.
Hits add Rot and splash a small pool of bile.
gear.mysticalterrain.pharaohs_khopesh.pr: Hurl a crossing crescent of sand: pierces, blinds, +1 Seal.
Sun-forged: flies farther, ignites and bursts at the end.
gear.mysticalterrain.pharaohs_khopesh.al: Hook a foe and drag it in (big foes pull you), then reap.
The hook chains on to two more foes.
gear.mysticalterrain.pharaohs_khopesh.ch: Hold, then leap and chop down; breaks Seals for bonus damage.
The Scales of Ma'at: every Sealed foe within 10 is judged.
gear.mysticalterrain.pharaohs_khopesh.pa: +1 Seal per hit; 3 Seals Entomb a foe for 1.5 s.
gear.mysticalterrain.crook_of_sekhmar.pr: A piercing ray of sunlight: burns and Seals all in its line.
Three rays fan out at once.
gear.mysticalterrain.crook_of_sekhmar.al: Three sun pillars fall where you aim; leaves Sunlit Ground.
Six pillars, and a wider, longer-lasting Sunlit Ground.
gear.mysticalterrain.crook_of_sekhmar.ch: Hold to grow a sun; release to hurl it where you aim.
The sun splits into three as it falls.
gear.mysticalterrain.crook_of_sekhmar.pa: Ignites; burning foes also gain a Seal.
gear.mysticalterrain.scarab_flail.primar: Three lashes; the last crashes down, slowing and weakening.
Each lash flings a scarab onto a foe it hits.
gear.mysticalterrain.scarab_flail.altern: Loose 6 scarabs that hunt foes, latch on and devour them.
Ten scarabs, and each bursts when it lets go.
gear.mysticalterrain.scarab_flail.charge: Hold to whirl, then slam and roll a burning sun forward.
Two smaller suns roll out beside it.
gear.mysticalterrain.scarab_flail.passiv: Every 3rd hit, a scarab latches onto the foe.
Three spore-laced slashes; the last flings a gill crescent.
Three crescents fan out, each infesting twice.
gear.mysticalterrain.sporeblade.alternat: Burrow up to 14 blocks and burst up in a ring of roots.
The tunnel behind you erupts in hyphal spikes.
gear.mysticalterrain.sporeblade.charge.d: Hold: each level adds a slash and lengthens the crescent.
Hits infest; at 5 stacks foes Sporeburst, spreading the rot.
gear.mysticalterrain.mycelial_maul.prima: Crash down; a root fissure races 8 blocks and leaves blight.
Two more fissures split off at an angle.
gear.mysticalterrain.mycelial_maul.alter: Vault on a spore burst; the crater rings with puffball mines.
Six mines, and the crater festers with blight.
gear.mysticalterrain.mycelial_maul.charg: Hold to drag foes into a spore maelstrom; release to crush.
The maelstrom lingers, dragging and rotting foes.
gear.mysticalterrain.mycelial_maul.passi: Hits infest the target and every foe within 2.5 blocks.
gear.mysticalterrain.sporecaster.primary: Lob three puffballs that burst in infesting spores.
Five puffballs; each leaves a puffball mine.
gear.mysticalterrain.sporecaster.alterna: Channel a 10-block cone of spores for 1 s; aim to sweep it.
Longer and wider; the last gust bursts heavy infestations.
Hold to call down waves of deathcap spores on your aim.
The falling spores seek out infested foes.
gear.mysticalterrain.sporecaster.passive: Hits harvest Infestation: 3 damage and 1 health per stack.
gear.mysticalterrain.runeblade.primary.d: A wide spectral cleave; each foe hit conjures a Phantom Blade.
gear.mysticalterrain.runeblade.primary.e: A backhand rend follows and fills your Phantom Blades.
gear.mysticalterrain.runeblade.alternate: Phase-slide ahead or to a Glyphstone; your afterimage cuts.
The afterimage cuts twice; brief Resistance II.
gear.mysticalterrain.runeblade.charge.de: Hold to raise a halo of blades; release to rain them down.
gear.mysticalterrain.runeblade.charge.em: Two more blades, and the Verdict strikes at any charge.
gear.mysticalterrain.runeblade.passive.d: Every 2nd hit conjures a Phantom Blade (max 3): +1.5 per blade.
gear.mysticalterrain.archon_focus.primar: Three homing rune missiles; each Glyphstone fires one too.
Two volleys, and every Glyphstone fires twice.
gear.mysticalterrain.archon_focus.altern: Cage a foe in runes; the cage shatters into a Glyphstone.
The prison chains to two more foes nearby.
gear.mysticalterrain.archon_focus.charge: Hold, then release a steerable beam; Glyphstones refract it.
A wider beam that splits into a prism at the first foe.
gear.mysticalterrain.archon_focus.passiv: Every 3rd hit arcs lightning through up to 4 foes.
gear.mysticalterrain.sigil_hammer.primar: Stamp a sigil into the ground; a Glyphstone rises from it.
The sigil detonates again in a wider ring.
gear.mysticalterrain.sigil_hammer.altern: Hurl a sigil: foes are lifted, held, then crushed down.
Pulls foes in first, and the crushed are Weakened.
gear.mysticalterrain.sigil_hammer.charge: Hold to raise the hammer: a wider slam; full charge aftershocks.
gear.mysticalterrain.sigil_hammer.passiv: Hits splash runes; foes near a Glyphstone take a ley arc.
gear.mysticalterrain.starspear.primary.d: Lunge and pierce a 9-block line with starlight.
gear.mysticalterrain.starspear.primary.e: Reaches 14 blocks; stars fall on all it pierces.
gear.mysticalterrain.starspear.alternate: Soar up and crash down as a comet where you aim.
gear.mysticalterrain.starspear.charge.de: Hurl a piercing javelin of starlight that detonates.
gear.mysticalterrain.starspear.charge.em: Five falling stars rain around the blast.
gear.mysticalterrain.starspear.passive.d: Hits brand foes; the third brand bursts with starfire.
gear.mysticalterrain.halo_chakram.primar: Throw the halo; it ricochets through up to 5 foes.
gear.mysticalterrain.halo_chakram.altern: Blink behind a foe; your afterimage explodes.
gear.mysticalterrain.halo_chakram.charge: 2-4 star blades orbit you, cutting foes and projectiles.
gear.mysticalterrain.halo_chakram.passiv: Every 3rd hit flings a shard that ricochets to 2 foes.
gear.mysticalterrain.nova_greatsword.pri: Overhead cleave that tears a fissure of starlight.
Tears three fissures in a fan.
gear.mysticalterrain.nova_greatsword.alt: Hurl a collapsing star that drags foes in, then implodes.
gear.mysticalterrain.nova_greatsword.cha: Hold to swell the core; release a starfire nova.
The spent star collapses and bursts again.
gear.mysticalterrain.nova_greatsword.pas: Every 4th hit bursts; hits consume Starbrands for damage.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.ender_dragon.tw: Falls land as a shockwave instead of hurting; no Darkness.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.ender_dragon.fo: 3 orbiting crystal shards each block one attack, then burst.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.ender_dragon.ac: Rise in a cocoon of wings, then burst in a white nova.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.pyraxis.two_pie: Fire-immune; fire, lava and your own magma heal you.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.pyraxis.four_pi: Crust: absorbs 8, sears attackers; breaks into Strength + Speed.
Draw foes in and go supernova; Heat detonates, a caldera burns.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.hrimthane.two_p: Freeze-immune, frost-walking; a rime carapace absorbs 4 (12 s).
gear.mysticalterrain.set.hrimthane.four_: Nearby foes gain Rime every 2 s; attackers gain 2 Rime.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.hrimthane.activ: Rear up and detonate: 5 Rime to all within 8, then a blizzard.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.lirael.two_piec: Moonlit Grace: no fall damage, sneak to glide, night regen.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.lirael.four_pie: Attackers take thorns; Last Bloom cheats death every 3 min.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.lirael.active.d: Three waves of blooming thorns ring out, then harvest all.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.grothmaw.two_pi: Regrow 2 hearts of bone plating every 12 seconds.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.grothmaw.four_p: Hits build Fury; full Fury or low health: 8 s of Primal Rage.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.grothmaw.active: Roar in a cone to terrify foes and bring down boulders.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.hollow_warden.t: Night vision, no Darkness or Blindness; sneak to vanish.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.hollow_warden.f: Attackers gain a Sentence; freed souls ward you (2 hearts).
gear.mysticalterrain.set.hollow_warden.a: Chain foes to you, drag them in and Condemn them.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.bogrot.two_piec: Poison immune, water breathing; mend in water, rain or pools.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.bogrot.four_pie: Attackers gain Rot; near death the willow hair wards you.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.bogrot.active.d: Drag foes in, crush them in a maw of roots, exhale rot.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.sekhmar.two_pie: Blindness-proof; swift on sand; your Sunlit Ground heals you.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.sekhmar.four_pi: Attackers gain a Seal; the Ankh cheats death once per 5 min.
Four sun rays wheel around you for 2.5 s, then a sun nova.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.mycelord.two_pi: Immune to poison, wither and nausea; attackers are infested.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.mycelord.four_p: Your Sporebursts heal you; below 30%% a shelf-shell ward forms.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.mycelord.active: A violet nova detonates all Infestation; leaves a fairy ring.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.archon.two_piec: Deflect a projectile every 8 s as a rune bolt; stones last 20 s.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.archon.four_pie: Seeds Glyphstones; near one: Resistance I, Regen I, stones fire.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.archon.active.d: A burning pentagram around you; Glyphstones empower it.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.astrael.two_pie: Jump Boost; sneak mid-air to glide; night-sky regeneration.
gear.mysticalterrain.set.astrael.four_pi: A starlight ward re-forms every 20s and bursts when broken.
Chain up to 6 foes in starlight, then ignite the web.
